question: Two stations, A and B, are 1570 km apart. One train starts from A at 7:00 am and travels towards B at 80 km/h. Another train starts from B at 9:00 am and travels towards A at a speed of 108 km/h. At what time (in 24-hour clock time) will the two trains meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Distance between stations A and B = 1570 km

Speed of Train 1 (from A) = 80 km/h

Departure time of Train 1 = 7:00 am

Speed of Train 2 (from B) = 108 km/h

Departure time of Train 2 = 9:00 am

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (when trains move towards each other) = Speed of Train 1 + Speed of Train 2

Distance covered = Relative speed × Time

Meeting
